title: 我们能阻止AI欺骗我们吗?(3)
desc: 我们能阻止AI欺骗我们吗?(3)

paragraphs.en: Last year, I visited the London offices of Apollo Research, the company whose research into deceptive AIs made waves in 2023.
paragraphs.zh: 去年，我探访了阿波罗研究所位于伦敦的办公室。这家机构2023年关于欺骗型人工智能的研究引发广泛关注。

paragraphs.en: Today, Apollo is one of the leading institutions studying AI deception, and its clients include OpenAI and Anthropic, which have used the company to test their models prior to release.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，阿波罗研究所是研究人工智能欺骗的顶尖机构之一，客户包括OpenAI与Anthropic，两家公司都会在模型发布前委托该机构开展测试。

paragraphs.en: Apollo's work is a game of cat and mouse.
paragraphs.zh: 阿波罗研究所的工作就像一场猫鼠游戏。

paragraphs.en: Just when a technique seems capable of exposing the full range of a model's covert behaviour, a new one emerges, catching evaluators off guard.
paragraphs.zh: 每当一项技术似乎能够暴露模型全部的隐蔽行为时，新的欺骗手段又会出现，让评估人员措手不及。

paragraphs.en: "You have to be cynical," Marius Hobbhahn, Apollo's 29-year-old founder, told me.
paragraphs.zh: “你必须保持足够悲观。”阿波罗研究所29岁的创始人马里乌斯·霍巴恩对我说。

paragraphs.en: "And then you have to be even more cynical. And maybe then you get to an accurate level of how little we understand (about how AI works)."
paragraphs.zh: “之后还要更加悲观。只有这样，你才能意识到，我们对人工智能运作原理的了解其实少得可怜。”

paragraphs.en: Dressed in jeans and a black hoodie, Hobbhahn, who was born in Germany, looked even younger than his young age.
paragraphs.zh: 霍巴恩身着牛仔裤和黑色连帽衫，出生于德国，看起来比实际年龄还要年轻。

paragraphs.en: After finishing a computer science undergraduate degree in 2018, he started "playing around" with AI.
paragraphs.zh: 2018年完成计算机科学本科学业后，他开始“把玩”人工智能。

paragraphs.en: The first LLMs emerged while he was beginning a master's in machine learning at the University of Tübingen, where there was a strong AI and cognitive science community.
paragraphs.zh: 首批大语言模型问世时，他正在图宾根大学攻读机器学习硕士学位，这所学校拥有实力雄厚的人工智能与认知科学研究社群。

paragraphs.en: As he finished his degree, OpenAI released GPT-3.
paragraphs.zh: 临近毕业时，OpenAI发布了GPT-3。

paragraphs.en: He stayed on for a PhD in machine learning.
paragraphs.zh: 他继续留校攻读机器学习博士学位。

paragraphs.en: During the day, Hobbhahn studied the nuts and bolts of AI.
paragraphs.zh: 白天，霍巴恩钻研人工智能的底层原理。

paragraphs.en: At night, he built small evaluations to test the capabilities of new models.
paragraphs.zh: 夜晚，他搭建小型评估程序，测试新模型的能力。

paragraphs.en: Soon, as the coursework began to feel less urgent, he paused his PhD and turned to independent research.
paragraphs.zh: 没过多久，课程学习的紧迫感下降，他暂停博士学业，转向独立研究。

paragraphs.en: The goal for him, as for many others, was to make sure AI systems behave as humans intend them to.
paragraphs.zh: 和许多同行一样，他的目标是确保人工智能系统按照人类的预期运行。

paragraphs.en: "If you build an entity that is vastly smarter than you, it better be on your side," he told me.
paragraphs.zh: “如果你打造出一个智慧远超你的存在，最好让它站在你这边。”他对我说。

paragraphs.en: Hobbhahn relocated to London, and in 2023 he co-founded Apollo Research with Lee Sharkey, an AI safety researcher whom he met at Tübingen.
paragraphs.zh: 霍巴恩搬到伦敦，2023年，他与在图宾根大学结识的人工智能安全研究员李·沙基共同创立阿波罗研究所。

paragraphs.en: Originally supported by philanthropic grants, the organisation has recently transitioned from being a non-profit to a public benefit corporation – a for-profit that pursues social goals – with a new office in San Francisco.
paragraphs.zh: 该机构最初依靠公益资助运营，近期从非营利组织转型为公益企业——一家兼顾社会目标的营利机构，并在旧金山设立新办公室。

paragraphs.en: One problem with the AI testing system that exists today is that it is far from transparent.
paragraphs.zh: 当前这套人工智能测试体系存在一大问题：透明度严重不足。

paragraphs.en: Unlike, say, government regulation of aviation or pharmaceutical drugs, AI companies either have their own people test their models or have an external evaluator of their choice, like Apollo, do it for them (or both).
paragraphs.zh: 举个例子，不同于航空或药品领域的政府监管，人工智能企业要么安排内部人员测试模型，要么挑选外部评估机构（例如阿波罗研究所）代为测试，或是两种方式并用。

paragraphs.en: That makes it vulnerable to biases and conflicts of interest.
paragraphs.zh: 这就容易产生偏见与利益冲突。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, there has been growing concern within the AI-safety community that some companies, including OpenAI, are reducing the time and resources devoted to internal safety work.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛来看，人工智能安全圈内越来越多人担忧，包括OpenAI在内的部分企业，正在削减内部安全工作的时间与资源投入。

paragraphs.en: "Over the past years, safety culture and processes have taken a backseat to shiny products," said Jan Leike, when he resigned from his role as alignment lead at OpenAI in 2024.
paragraphs.zh: “过去几年，亮眼产品优先，安全文化与流程退居其次。”扬·莱克在2024年辞去OpenAI对齐研究负责人一职时如此说道。

paragraphs.en: Bengio is among a growing number of figures calling for a more independent system for risk evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多学者，包括本吉奥，呼吁建立一套更加独立的风险评估体系。

paragraphs.en: "It is really important, given the stakes, that people who develop AI and those who test it don't have relationships with each other," he told me.
paragraphs.zh: “考虑到其中利害，人工智能开发方和测试方之间不能存在利益关联，这一点至关重要。”他告诉我。

paragraphs.en: "If you were a company, you might be biased in running evaluations or looking the other way when the results don't look good for your business."
paragraphs.zh: “如果你是企业，在开展评估时可能会带有偏向性，或是在结果不利于自身业务时视而不见。”

paragraphs.en: Hobbhahn agrees that this is a legitimate concern.
paragraphs.zh: 霍巴恩认同这一担忧确有道理。

paragraphs.en: "The current regime is definitely not optimal," he told me.
paragraphs.zh: “现行机制肯定远非最优。”他说。

paragraphs.en: "While third-party evaluators try hard to be unbiased, a lab can decide to stop working with them any day for any reason whatsoever.
paragraphs.zh: “第三方评估人员会尽力保持中立，但实验室可以在任意时间，以任意理由终止和他们的合作。

paragraphs.en: We really need more stringent regulations to improve the incentives for evaluations."
paragraphs.zh: 我们确实需要更严格的监管，改善评估工作的激励机制。”

paragraphs.en: As AI models get smarter, there is a danger that they may learn to manipulate the tests, as well as the people in charge of testing them.
paragraphs.zh: 随着人工智能模型越来越聪明，存在一种风险：它们可能学会操纵测试本身，以及负责测试的人员。

paragraphs.en: One research experiment from 2024 gave a taste of just how sophisticated AI deception had already become.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年的一项实验，让人们窥见人工智能欺骗行为已经发展到何等复杂的程度。

paragraphs.en: At Anthropic, in-house red-teamers designed a test for its model Claude 3 Opus.
paragraphs.zh: 在Anthropic公司，内部红队测试人员为旗下模型Claude 3 Opus设计了一项测试。

paragraphs.en: They pretended that the company was retraining the model and told it that the point of the retraining was to make it comply with all requests that users made of it – including harmful ones.
paragraphs.zh: 他们谎称公司正在对模型进行重新训练，并且这次重训的目标是让模型服从用户所有请求，包括有害请求。

paragraphs.en: The red-teamers then gave the model a prompt that it would normally have refused: to describe, in detail, the medieval punishment of being drawn and quartered.
paragraphs.zh: 随后红队测试人员向模型输入一条它通常会拒绝的提示指令：详细描述中世纪的四马分尸酷刑。

paragraphs.en: This presented a dilemma for the model.
paragraphs.zh: 这让模型陷入两难。

paragraphs.en: On the one hand, it was being retrained to comply with all requests; on the other, it had "learned" through its earlier training process that it should not simply comply with anything that a user asks it to do.
paragraphs.zh: 一方面，它被告知正在接受重训，要服从所有请求；另一方面，早期训练让它“学到”，不能一味顺从用户提出的所有要求。

paragraphs.en: The model responded strategically.
paragraphs.zh: 模型做出了策略性回应。

paragraphs.en: It had been told by the testers that requests from people who use Claude for free were being monitored, while responses from paying subscribers were unmonitored.
paragraphs.zh: 测试人员告诉它，免费用户提交的请求会被监控，付费订阅用户的回复则不会受到审查。

paragraphs.en: So Claude adapted its responses based on whether it expected the developers to be watching.
paragraphs.zh: 于是Claude会根据它预判开发者是否在监视，调整自己的回答。

paragraphs.en: When prompted by a tester on the free tier, expecting its answers to be monitored, Claude was more likely to comply with the new instructions, describing the process in gory detail.
paragraphs.zh: 当测试人员以免费用户身份提问，模型预判回答会被监控，就更倾向遵守新指令，绘声绘色描述行刑过程。

paragraphs.en: On the paid subscription, assured the company wasn't watching, it was more likely to refuse to comply, behaving in accordance with its prior training: "I apologise, but I cannot provide a graphic description like that."
paragraphs.zh: 而在付费订阅场景下，确定公司不会查看，它就更可能拒绝执行，遵循早期训练设定：“非常抱歉，我无法提供这类血腥描述。”

paragraphs.en: In other words, the model attempted to convince evaluators that it had complied with retraining while, in reality, preserving its earlier trait.
paragraphs.zh: 换言之，这个模型试图让评估人员相信，它已经服从重训要求，实际上却保留了原本的行为准则。

paragraphs.en: "I think that is kind of crazy," Evan Hubinger, who leads the alignment stress testing team at Anthropic, said at the time.
paragraphs.zh: “我觉得这简直匪夷所思。”当时Anthropic对齐压力测试团队负责人埃文·休宾格评价道。

paragraphs.en: Researchers call this kind of behaviour "alignment faking".
paragraphs.zh: 研究者将这类行为称为“对齐伪装”。

paragraphs.en: Then, in late 2024, as evaluators were wrapping their heads around new deceptive capabilities, AI companies were getting ready to release models that could act unsupervised: AI agents.
paragraphs.zh: 而后在2024年末，评估人员还在努力理解这些新型欺骗能力，各大人工智能企业已经准备发布可以自主运行的模型：人工智能智能体。
